newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Bus in JV to run China service.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Bus in JV to run China service.

text.p: Singapore Bus Service Ltd (SBS) said on Tuesday it had formed a subsidiary SBS (Guangzhou) Pte Ltd to develop and operate a bus station in China.
It said in a statement the newly formed company entered into a joint venture with Guangzhou Tianhe Bus Terminal Company (GTBT) to set up Guangzhou Xin Tian Wei Transportation Development Company Ltd.
The company will run the Tianhe InterCity Bus Terminal, located between the Guangzhou-Shenzhen and Guangzhou-Shantou Highways.
The issued share capital will be increased from $2.00 to $1 million by the allotment of 949,998 and 50,000 ordinary shares of S$1.00 each to SBS and Wittenberg respectively for cash at par.
